parsed.rationale: Four separate packages — Playlist, Core, Playback, and MusicShareKit — each declare an unnamed extension on URLSession in unrelated files. The canonical home for cross-cutting URLSession behaviour already exists in the Core package at 'Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Models and Services/URLSession+WebSession.swift', which is the natural consolidation target since all other packages are expected to depend on Core. Consolidating the scattered extensions there eliminates the name-collision risk surfaced by the pipeline and makes URLSession augmentation discoverable in one place. None of the records carry test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, so there is no intentional-duplication justification.
